body.query: My certificate from abroad needs to be accepted
body.interpreted_need: Get an overseas university degree recognised

service.title: Set up UAE PASS to sign in to online services
service.summary: UAE PASS is the sign-in used by federal online services. MoFA's online attestation application and ICP's smart services both state that you sign in with UAE PASS.

eligibility_criteria.text: MoFA's online attestation for documents issued outside the UAE requires signing in with UAE PASS.

sources.title: Issuing Residency Permit

results.authority_notice: Only UAE PASS can decide whether this service applies to you. This guidance is not an eligibility decision.

service.title: Get a university qualification from abroad recognised
service.summary: MoHESR's University Qualifications Recognition service reviews qualifications from accredited institutions outside the UAE. The recognition report can be used for employment, further study, visas and UAE government services.
service.entity: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR)

eligibility_criteria.text: The qualification is from an accredited institution outside the UAE.
Qualifications from licensed institutions inside the UAE use a separate MoHESR service.

reasons.text: Not known yet: degree issued outside uae. Criterion: The qualification is from an accredited institution outside the UAE.

service.title: Attest a document issued outside the UAE
service.summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs attests documents issued abroad through UAE missions in the country of issue. You apply online with UAE PASS where the mission offers it, or visit the mission in person.
service.entity: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) and UAE missions abroad

eligibility_criteria.text: The document was issued outside the UAE.
Apply through 'Attestation through UAE Missions Abroad'. The service is available through selected missions; if it is not offered online, visit the UAE mission in person.

Example from one mission: documents are first attested by the issuing country's foreign office, and documents must be attested by the UAE embassy or consulate in the country where they were issued. Check the mission for your country.

documents.text: The original document (for example, your degree certificate). Mission courier services collect the original.
Proof that the issuing country's foreign office attested the document, where your mission requires it.

sources.title: UAE Embassy in Rabat: attestation information

results.authority_notice: Only the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the UAE mission in the issuing country can decide whether this service applies to you. This guidance is not an eligibility decision.

service.title: Verify your degree through an authorised verification partner
service.summary: News reporting says MoHESR appointed authorised partners to verify foreign degrees before you apply for recognition. We have not confirmed this on an official MoHESR page, so treat it as something to check.

eligibility_criteria.text: Reported to apply to qualifications issued outside the UAE that need MoHESR recognition.
